why: Angle: a screen-reader user hears this mid-animation and wants to know what pressing it does, so the label states the action and where it leads. «דלג לסוף» is the standard media-player phrasing, and at 8 visible characters it fits the 16-character limit. It stays in the same imperative form as «הפעל שוב», so the two states sound like one button. Without vowels, «דלג» can be read as past tense (דִּלֵּג), so the niqqud fixes it as the imperative. If the aria-label field strips niqqud, use «לדלג לסוף» instead, since the infinitive has only one reading. Flag → Noa: the approved «הפעל שוב» has the same risk, because a TTS engine can read it as «הֻפְעַל». Consider «הַפְעֵל שוב» there.
